summary: Code quality is excellent—well-structured module, proper PowerShell conventions (ErrorActionPreference=Stop, parameter validation), YAML best practices (pinned v4, least-privilege permissions, job dependencies, shell: pwsh). However, critical incompleteness: fixture files (fixtures/cases/*.json, fixtures/secrets.json) are missing. The workflow defaults to fixtures/secrets.json, which doesn't exist, causing failures on push/PR/schedule triggers. Run-ActTests.ps1 cannot execute without fixtures, preventing generation of the required act-result.txt artifact. Solution is non-functional as delivered.
